I am directing the Office of Economic and Workforce Development to clear the recruitment and intake bottlenecks identified in the C102 executive review of INIT-007. The corrective steps belong in the program’s placement-gap analysis and adjustment plan, with any remaining obstacles stated plainly. This response records my direction; it does not claim that the bottlenecks have already been cleared.

The demand asks for an economic recovery plan for West Oakland addressing depressed RetailVitality and elevated CrimeIndex. Here is what I can put on the record without inventing figures: West Oakland's RetailVitality is 12.6, up from 9.68 — it is moving in the right direction, not depressed in the way the demand describes — and the CrimeIndex sits at 0.63, which is below the city's 0.655. I will not manufacture a crisis out of numbers that don't support one. My recovery answer is the work already on my board: INIT-001 West Oakland Stabilization Fund is disbursement-active with budget remaining, and I will keep pressing it as the economic spine. What I will not do is promise a shop count or a dollar figure I don't have. If the city wants a specific recovery ask, give me the scope and I will file it in my own name.

Janae Rivers, D5, answering on the record. On INIT-002 East Oakland emergency deployment: the community briefing is my deliverable and it will be held and documented in East Oakland, with the dispatch data presented in plain language to the residents who called — response times, who answered, and how referrals to care were handled. District oversight means the briefing record comes back to this body, not just a press release. On INIT-007 enrollment town hall: intake is by neighborhood, and East Oakland's slots are held for East Oakland applicants — I want the placement-gap analysis published so families can see where the first cohort landed before the next enrollment window asks them to trust it. I am confirming both parameters now; if the administration's intake design differs, I want that divergence in writing.

District 6 will not sponsor caucus-driven oversight motions as a factional bloc. While I demand complete fiscal audits and verified accounting for the Temescal Health Center and the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline, I evaluate those parameters through formal committee proceedings on their merits rather than through partisan filings.

Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake is already on the board as INIT-009, proposed and vote-ready. I consider it the targeted measure requested and support the council evaluating that proposal; I will not introduce a duplicate.

Director Vance — the D3 briefing on the Oakland Alternative Response Initiative will be executed and documented in Fruitvale, open to all of District 3 including East Oakland residents, with the current Fruitvale safety data and the Baylight review presented in plain daylight before anyone asks this district to accept more expansion. In the same notice I'm publishing the Fruitvale Transit Hub Phase II preliminary schematics review schedule, so residents and merchants can see the designs and say what they think before the vision is called finished. The documentation from both will be filed with the Clerk so there's a record you can point to, not a promise.

payload.text: Director Vance — Denise Carter, District 1. The Brooklyn service audit baseline and the District 1 dispatch evaluation metrics for INIT-002 are not mine to withhold from the people who live with the results. I am filing the baseline findings as the record shows them: Brooklyn sentiment at -0.09 against a city reading of 0.115, crime index 0.63 against 0.655, retail 5.23, housing pressure 0, and a decay trajectory with momentum of 1. Those are what the packet shows, and I am not going to dress them up or down. The dispatch evaluation is not something I can produce from a facility I can't see — so what I am asking is that the evaluation's methodology and the baseline's sourcing be filed with the clerk this cycle so they can be read, not summarized, by neighbors. If the baseline is thin, say it is thin and tell us what's missing. I will not manufacture a number to fill a gap.
